name: humbee-design-system
description: Humbee Design System — React/MUI UI component library (extracted bundle for vendor use).

notes.@mui/system: Not listed explicitly — resolves transitively via @mui/material.
notes.@mui/icons-material: Used by the design system but was NOT in the source app's package.json; install it explicitly.
notes.styled-components / react-icons / prop-t: Each used by only 1-2 files. They were absent from the source app's package.json, so they may be trimmable dead imports — verify before shipping to production.
notes.@amcharts/amcharts5: Only needed if you use the Chart/ components (LineTrend, ClusteredColumn, HorizontalBar, StackedColumn).
